    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Board
    Represents the game board with a unified cell system.
    Cell
    Represents a generic cell on the game board that can contain various types of content.
    CellContent
    Interface for all types of cell content in the game.
    Character
    Abstract class representing a character in the game.
    DefensiveEquipment
    Abstract class representing defensive equipment that can be used by characters.
    Dice
    The Dice interface defines the contract for all dice types in the game.
    Dragon
    Represents a dragon enemy in the game.
    Enemy
    Abstract class representing an enemy character in the game.
    Game
    The Game class handles the core game logic, including character creation, player movement, and game state management.
    GameState
    Tracks the game state, including boss status and other game-wide information.
    Goblin
    Represents a goblin enemy in the game.
    LinkDB
    The LinkDB class handles database connections for the game.
    Menu
    The Menu class handles user interactions, such as displaying messages and capturing user input.
    MysteryBox
    Represents a mystery box that contains random equipment.
    OffensiveEquipment
    Abstract class representing offensive equipment that can be used by characters.
    Orc
    Represents an orc enemy in the game.
    OutOfBoardException
    Exception thrown when the player exceeds the board's maximum position.
    Potion
    A Potion is a defensive equipment that characters can use to restore health or gain temporary buffs.
    Shield
    A Shield is a defensive equipment that characters can use to protect themselves.
    SimpleDatabaseManager
    A simplified database manager that only handles character and equipment saving/loading.
    SixSidedDice
    The SixSidedDice class simulates a six-sided dice for determining player movement.
    Sorcerer
    Represents a sorcerer enemy in the game.
    Spell
    A Spell is an offensive equipment that characters can use to cast magical attacks.
    Test
    The Test class provides a simple way to test database connectivity and verify that the database schema is correctly set up.
    TwentySidedDice
    The TwentySidedDice class simulates a twenty-sided dice for determining critical hits (rolling 20) and critical misses (rolling 1).
    Warrior
    A Warrior is a character type with high health points and strong offensive equipment.
    Weapon
    A Weapon is an offensive equipment that characters can use to attack enemies.
    Wizard
    A Wizard is a character type with magical abilities and potent spells.
